title: Embedded OT field-device TRA template
description: A reusable starting point (mock TRA) for a generic embedded OT field device. Copy into projects/<id>/ and adapt. Pre-seeds the mandatory attacker profiles, a typical interface set and the common threats from the shared library.

scope.boundary: The device enclosure and all its interfaces; the plant network and engineering tools are external.

attacker.name: Opportunistic proximity attacker
attacker.text: Near the device during operation/maintenance; public tooling.

attacker.name: Malicious insider / on-site
attacker.text: Physical access to the enclosure and wiring.

attacker.name: Remote network adversary
attacker.text: Reaches the device only if a routable interface is fitted and unsegmented.
